diagnostics.paper_buy_definition: STRONG_EDGE + executable best_ask + passing exclusive family coverage + minimum historical calibration sample
diagnostics.calibration: Historical forecast errors are measured only when the forecast existed before the target local day started.
diagnostics.bias_correction: Forecast value is adjusted by historical forecast bias.
diagnostics.sigma_model: Combined model uncertainty plus between-model disagreement.
diagnostics.cumulative_bucket_handling: or_lower/or_higher are evaluated directly and excluded from exclusive family normalization.
